reviewType: visual and read-only pixel-edge QA under canonical NO_LOGO policy

criteria.source: master-no-logo-ai-tight.png only; no logo reference; no generated output as reference
criteria.architecture: complete frontal y118 door with full frame, unchanged side fields, central rib array, two mesh sections and threshold
criteria.framing: complete frame visible with 0-8 px near-white outer margin
criteria.branding: zero logos, zero WONLY marks, zero plaques and zero text
criteria.hardware: one slim black lock with exactly two plain circular sensors and one blank lower rectangle; no letters, digits, labels, pseudo-writing or microtext
criteria.derivation: untouched raw direct built-in ImageGen PNG; no filter, recolor, mask, crop, resize, composite, repair or conversion

marginDetection.method: First row/column containing any RGB channel below 245, read-only scan from each original edge

rejectedNotes: Three original attempts, one anthracite attempt and one oak attempt were rejected for excessive margin, pseudo-text, extra sensor, or ghost mark. They remain isolated under _rejected and are not active.
notes: Accepted files are raw built-in ImageGen outputs copied byte-for-byte into staging. No conversion or public promotion was performed.
